title: Easy to install!  Concerns listed in description.
text:
Easy to install! Concerns listed in description.. This item is very easy to install. Hook the clips or tie wrap (both included) the tubing to your air conditioner unit, then the connect the water hose. Let the solar panel charge the batteries or plug it in (your choice) and it's ready to go. I can't attest to whether or not it actually lowers my electric bill yet but it definitely puts off a cool, fine mist that has to help down here in S. Louisiana. There is even an instructional video, you can watch online for installation. So easy!

After a few days, the little misters started leaking. I tried adjusting, it helped some but still spurts out some water.

I'm now concerned about the hard water we have here and what others have stated concerning build up on the coils. I will be removing this product until further research.
